categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in animal husbandry, focusing on cattle breeding and beef cattle farming, which constitute about 80% of its business. It also engages in frozen semen and embryo production and sales, live cattle breeding and sales, fresh beef processing and sales, land leasing, and dairy product sales. Additionally, it provides related livestock technology consulting and services, and operates non-residential real estate leasing and equipment leasing businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced breeding technologies including frozen semen production using fine-tube frozen semen technology, embryo transplantation, and genetic evaluation through progeny testing. It employs TMR (Total Mixed Ration) feeding technology for fattening cattle to improve feed conversion and meat quality. The company has established a comprehensive breeding and reproduction system integrating breeding, disease prevention, nutrition, and scientific feeding management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized ranches, breeding cooperatives, individual farmers, slaughterhouses, supply chain companies, restaurant chains, and online fresh food platforms. The company serves the domestic Chinese market, particularly targeting regions with significant cattle farming activities and beef consumption, including Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, and Guangdong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant presence in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia for breeding and farming activities. It has expanded downstream operations such as slaughtering and fresh beef sales in Guangdong and the Greater Bay Area. It also has subsidiaries and investments in regions like Ningxia, Jilin, and other key cattle farming areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the beef cattle supply chain, including upstream genetic breeding and frozen semen production, midstream cattle breeding and fattening, and downstream live cattle trading, slaughtering, meat processing, and fresh beef sales. It aims to build a closed-loop, vertically integrated supply chain from breeding to retail.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on strengthening its core breeding capabilities, improving genetic resources, and expanding vertically along the beef cattle industry chain. R&D priorities include enhancing frozen semen quality and production efficiency, developing local-adapted cattle breeds, and advancing breeding data platforms. The company also emphasizes training breeding technicians and expanding technical services to farmers to improve breeding and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of frozen semen and embryos, live cattle (including breeding and fattening cattle), fresh beef products, and leasing of agricultural land and equipment. The company also earns income from technical consulting services and government subsidies. Sales channels include government procurement, direct sales to ranches and cooperatives, and retail and wholesale of beef products through supply chains, restaurants, and online platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest and leading cattle breeding and frozen semen production enterprises in China, holding a dominant position in Xinjiang and significant market share nationally. It is recognized as a national-level breeding enterprise with a comprehensive genetic resource base. Competitors include other domestic cattle breeding and livestock companies, but the company’s integrated supply chain and genetic resource advantages provide competitive differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 137.6 million, a slight increase of 0.07% year-over-year. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 65.95 million, a significant increase in losses compared to the previous year. Total assets decreased by 21.26% to RMB 248.2 million, and shareholders’ equity turned negative. The company faces financial challenges but is actively pursuing strategic restructuring and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique genetic resource advantages, including a comprehensive gene pool of key cattle breeds like Holstein, Brown Swiss, Simmental, Angus, and Limousin. It offers high-quality frozen semen and embryos with proven breeding value, supported by advanced breeding technologies and a strong technical service system. Its vertically integrated supply chain from breeding to fresh beef sales ensures product quality and safety, aiming to provide premium, locally adapted beef products and comprehensive breeding solutions to customers.
